Former Ecuadorian President Lenín Moreno Sentenced for Corruption

Former Ecuadorian President Lenín Moreno has been sentenced to five years in prison for corruption. The conviction relates to a bribery scheme during his tenure. The sentencing was reported by international news outlets.
